_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 4% base rate of meaningful movement makes HOLD the skilled call, and the analyst's crosscurrent evidence (VIX 68, ETF collapse, stablecoin flight) prevents trusting the bullish analog enough to call UP.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward call is Disbelief/HOLD with medium conviction citing divergences; narrative implies recovery/HOP with 0.76 confidence trusting the analog. Split resolved by leaning analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00).
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive with stablecoin growth >45 and funding drops below 40 — genuine accumulation phase shift toward Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks >75 with DXY strengthening >101 and BTC funding flips negative — risk-off acceleration toward Anxiety/Panic
